cohort: The study participants were 788 patients with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) disorders who delivered at 25 high-volume hospitals in California between 2019 and 2021.
finding: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) patients who delivered at non-accreta centers were twice as likely to experience performance severe maternal morbidity (pSMM), though this finding was not statistically significant.
